## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] 提交信息遵循 Conventional Commits / Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` 本地通过 / passes locally
- [ ] 行为变化已补充或更新测试 / Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] 测试不提交真实 GPU 任务 / Tests never submit real GPU work
- [ ] 新增界面文本同时提供中英文 / New UI strings are bilingual (zh-CN + en-US)
- [ ] 用户可见变化已更新 CHANGELOG 和 README / CHANGELOG and README updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] 未提交 `config.json`、API Key、数据目录或参考音频 / No `config.json`, API keys, data directories or reference audio committed
